text: {"assertions":["A hang-on-exit bug in the deploy command (cli/commands/deploy.py) was caused by comparing a naive datetime against an aware datetime object.","The hang-on-exit bug only manifested for clients still pinned to the v1 SDK.","The bug's symptom was a process that completed its work but never returned or exited.","The fix involved making all boundary datetimes timezone-aware at the edge in the deploy command.","The fix was implemented in PR #1787 on branch fix/hang-on-exit-1.","The error rate for the deploy command decreased from 4.8% to under 0.06% (6 per ten thousand) after the fix.","The same area of cli/commands/deploy.py had previously experienced hang-on-exit issues, so context from earlier work carried over."]}
